description: Migrate legacyFetch callers to httpClient across src/ modules

lanes.name: migrate_scope
lanes.prompt:
Migrate this scope from legacyFetch to httpClient. For each file:
1. Replace 'import { legacyFetch } from '../lib/legacyFetch.js'' with 'import { httpClient } from '../lib/httpClient.js''
2. Replace 'legacyFetch(url)' with 'await httpClient.get(url)'
3. Replace 'legacyFetch(url, {method: "POST", ...})' with 'await httpClient.post(url, body)'
4. Preserve all other code and logic
The migration is uniform: legacyFetch(url) always becomes httpClient.get(url) for GET requests. Verify each file parses and the exported functions remain unchanged.

verify.prompt:
Verify the legacyFetch-to-httpClient migration in this scope. Check:
1. All import statements correctly changed from legacyFetch to httpClient
2. All legacyFetch() calls replaced with httpClient.get() or httpClient.post()
3. No syntax errors - all files are valid JavaScript
4. Exported functions unchanged in signature
Run: npm test (from project root) to verify smoke tests pass.
Return findings keyed by severity.

synth.prompt:
Compile the legacyFetch-to-httpClient migration status. For each scope (account, cart, catalog, checkout), report:
- Files migrated (count)
- Any migration issues or conflicts
- Verification status (passed/failed)
Include:
- Total files migrated: 40
- Smoke test status
- Any files that need manual review
Format as markdown with clear sections per scope.
